patch_description: The current program's flat, single-block ansatz underperforms (score 0.85) compared to the earlier modular two-block design (score 0.89) that used per-qubit RY/RX layers, a ring CRZ layer with alternating even/odd shared parameters, skip-2/skip-3 CRZ layers, and a diameter CRZ layer, all repeated twice for depth without doubling parameters. I'm reverting to that stronger modular structure and additionally applying the recommended refinement: split the skip-2 and skip-3 entanglers into alternating even/odd shared parameters (analogous to the successful ring layer's even/odd split), rather than a single shared parameter per skip distance. This should tighten mid-range entanglement expressivity at the cost of only +2 parameters, likely improving validation accuracy and shrinking the generalization gap below the prior 0.06.
